description: This file contains service functions for managing gym class bookings, including creating, canceling, and retrieving bookings for users and trainers. It interacts with database models and performs business logic related to gym session bookings.

methods.name: create_class_booking
methods.description: Creates a booking for a specific class session if spots are available and not already booked.

methods.name: cancel_class_booking
methods.description: Cancels a user's booking, with optional admin override, and updates session spots.

methods.name: get_trainer_bookings_for_user
methods.description: Retrieves bookings for a trainer associated with a user, returning relevant booking details.

methods.name: get_class_bookings_for_user
methods.description: Retrieves class bookings for a user, including session times and class titles.
